Sam V: Rashid from GulfCloud requested quick alignment for me-west-ksa-1 region. Asks: marketplace SKU entitlements, initial GPU reserve (12x A100-80), KMS/HSM pattern (in-region), and coordinated announce window. Can partnerships + security + ops advise?
Rashid (GulfCloud): We can allocate 12 A100-80 (gc-a100-80-prod) and allow burst to gc-a10-40 for best-effort. Require HSM-backed keys (CloudHSM or customer HSM). Rotation 90 days. Target go-live 2026-11-02.
Ava L: Ops needs SKU ids + go-live commitment + expected ramp to request quotas. Also suggest a two-week embargo for canaries.
Rashid (GulfCloud): SKUs: gc-a100-80-prod, gc-a10-40-burst. Ramp estimate: 2-4 customers first month. Lead time for extra commit ~8 business days.
Priya J: I'll draft entitlement payload and submit. Draft below for review: 
```json
{
  "partner":"GulfCloud",
  "region":"me-west-ksa-1",
  "skus":["gc-a100-80-prod","gc-a10-40-burst"],
  "reserved_capacity":12,
  "go_live_date":"2026-11-02"
}
```
Sam V: Legal/compliance 1: we need short addendum for in-region key custody and log residency. @LegalBot can you spin a draft?
LegalBot: Uploaded KMS addendum template to shared drive. Please review and request signature before go-live.
OpsBot: Proposed canary window 2026-10-26 09:00-12:00 UTC; success criteria: p95 < 250ms, sustained 500k tokens/hr, fallback < 30%. Notifying #eng-runtime #eng-sre.
Ava L: I'll schedule the internal run and draft the minimal runbook. Assignments: Priya entitlement + marketplace submit, LegalBot addendum, Ava ops/runbook, Rashid partner coordination.
Rashid (GulfCloud): We'll provide partner-side canary metrics and marketing blurb by next week. Excited to launch. :rocket:
